items.title: Deep Learning Approaches for Cultural Heritage Image Classification: A Survey
items.abstract: This paper provides a comprehensive survey of deep learning approaches applied to cultural heritage image classification, covering CNN, transformer, and multimodal methods.

items.title: Sustainable Heritage Conservation in Urban Contexts: A Framework for Chinese Historic Cities
items.abstract: This study proposes a sustainability framework for heritage conservation in rapidly urbanizing Chinese historic cities, integrating economic, social, and environmental dimensions.

items.title: Museology in the Digital Age: Visitor Experience Design with Mixed Reality
items.abstract: Exploring how mixed reality technologies transform museum visitor experiences and the implications for museological practice.

items.title: Intangible Cultural Heritage Documentation Using Blockchain Technology
items.abstract: We propose a blockchain-based system for immutable documentation and provenance tracking of intangible cultural heritage practices.

items.title: Archaeological Site Detection Using Satellite Imagery and Deep Learning
items.abstract: We present a novel deep learning pipeline for detecting archaeological sites from high-resolution satellite imagery across diverse geographic regions.

items.title: 社区参与视角下的传统村落文化遗产活化路径研究——以皖南古村落为例
items.abstract: 本文以皖南地区西递、宏村等6个传统村落为案例，通过参与式观察与半结构化访谈，探讨社区参与在传统村落文化遗产活化中的角色与机制。研究发现，社区主导型活化模式在文化传承可持续性、居民满意度方面显著优于政府主导型和企业主导型。文章提出「社区赋权-多元共治-利益共享」三阶活化路径框架。
